notes.title: Version update preview (1.1.0.0)
notes.content:
[h1]The details of the update are as follows,[/h1]
[list]
[*] All UIs in the game have been redone, UX experience has been optimized, and we hope that this time we can give players a better gaming experience.
[*] English and Spanish localization is now live, a lot of errors and inaccurate texts are fixed and updated.
[*] Three new boss level characters have been added!
[*] Values of some talents have been adjusted.
[*] Players are compensated with extra gold when remaining talents/skills are discarded in Labs.
[*] Several issues affecting game crashes and archiving have been fixed.
[/list]

Your feedback on in-game unbalanced data and bug issues or valuable gameplay suggestions are always welcome!

notes.title: Version update(1.0.2.7)
notes.content:
1. Skill casting has been optimized to significantly reduce stuttering and frame drops that now occur later in the game.
2. Warlock units cast abilities that heal friendly units first and deal damage to enemy units second.
3. Added a separate special effect to the healing effect of Warlock units.
4. Fixed several bug where characters could not be generated.
5. Fixed an issue where quick exit from the skill learning panel would cause character learning skills to disappear.
6. Fixed an issue where some skills would not take effect.

notes.title: Version Update (1.0.2.0)
notes.content:
1. This major update is a save optimization! Saving in the new version takes about one-eighth of the time it did before, and since the save time has been reduced to an acceptable level for players, we will be opening up the game's save feature completely. It is important to note that archives from older versions of the game will not be playable after this update, so lords, please hurry up and finish the rest of your journey!
2. Item values have been balanced.
3. Item enhancement will consume more resources.
4. Corrected some errors in the English text and UI display issues.
5. Fixed the problem of incorrect population upgrade data.
6. Fixed some talent text errors.
7. Fixed the problem of incorrect display of ties after loading.
8. Repair the problem that various stores will not update the time after loading the archive.
9. Fixed and adjusted other known issues, and made balance changes to some data.
The first discount has ended, all members of the Stardust Light Studio would like to thank the players for their trust, support and tolerance. In the future, we will continue to update the game content and do a good job of optimization, will be timely to repair the problems in the game, welcome the majority of players to monitor and put forward valuable suggestions!

notes.title: Version Update (1.0.1.1)
notes.content:
Hello everyone, the game has been updated to (1.0.1.1) version, we have fixed a lot of issues and bugs. The game currently has some unbalanced data, and we will continue to focus on these issues in the future and continue to improve. If you have any bug feedback or suggestions for game updates, we'd love to talk to you!
This update fixes 2 issues that caused errors in the game
1. Fixed an issue where purchases could not be made when the store was locked
2. Fixed an issue where characters in the lab would learn talents and skills incorrectly in English language.

notes.title: Version Update (1.0.1.0)
notes.content:
[h1] the specific updates are as follows [/h1]
1. Introducing a new feature called "turn-taking": players can adjust the maximum number of soldiers on the battlefield based on their computer performance, and both lords will send reinforcements according to the battle situation.
2. Adjusting the capture rate of characters: significantly increasing the capture rate in the early and mid-game stages, gradually decreasing in the later stage as enemies become stronger.
3. Balancing and adjusting multiple game openings: encouraging players to use different openings in the game.
4. Reducing the initial population upgrade cost (10->5).
5. Completely revamping the "Mage" ties: the new "Mage" ties will make the battle even crazier! Get ready for a magic frenzy!
6. Correcting talent descriptions in both Chinese and English, making them more accurate and clear.
7. Adding tutorial prompts in the laboratory, now the system will remind players to use captured units for melting.
8. Fixing item upgrade data overflow or incorrect issues.
9. Fixing potential character skill loss issues.
10. Fixing the problem where characters cannot be purchased in the shop.
11. Fixing and adjusting other known issues, as well as making some balance modifications to certain data.
Feel free to provide feedback on game imbalances, errors, or valuable suggestions!

notes.title: Version update (1.0.0.3)
notes.content:
We have received feedback from many players that there are too many captured units in the later stages of the game and that the battle levels are lagging. We will add a ‘turn-taking’ mechanism in the next update to solve the problem of lagging in the later stages of the game when there are too many units on the battlefield.
Specifically: players can adjust the maximum capacity of soldiers on the battlefield according to their own computer performance, and the system will adjust the number of units on the battlefield in real time according to the number of people on both sides.
[h1]The specific content of this update is as follows:[/h1]
1. Added a mechanism to reduce the capture rate in the later stages: as the number of levels increases, the probability of players capturing enemy units in battle will decrease.
2. The early levels will no longer have daunting high difficulty areas.
3. Optimise the UI logic of the character list.
4. Prisons will now get a lower resource return for banishment.
5. Fixed the problem of some talents not working.
6. Fixed the problem of item upgrade data overflow or error.
7. Fixed the issue that the current UI cannot be exited in some scenes.
8. Fixed and adjusted other known problems.
We welcome your feedback on in-game imbalance data and error problems or valuable game suggestions at any time!

notes.title: Version optimisation and update (1.0.0.2)
notes.content:
[h1]Stardust Light Studios apologises to players for the problems with the current version of the game. [/h1]
  The game's current development funds do not support our excellent localisation and beautiful human translation of the game. We have used translation software to do the translations, with the intention that English-speaking players will also be able to play our game as soon as possible. We apologise for any inconvenience this may have caused you and many other native English speakers.
  Our internal team has already begun to calibrate the Chinese and English texts on our own and to seek help from the English-speaking team. We have many enthusiastic players who want to help us optimise the game's text, and we'd like to thank you all for enjoying the game and giving us your feedback, as your sincere suggestions are the direction we're trying to improve.
  Currently we have recalibrated 80% of the English translation, but it still has many shortcomings, we will contact the professional English team to continue to optimise the translated text with players.
  Meanwhile, the game's save module often lags for more than 5 minutes in the later stages of the game due to the wide variety of data that can be modified and the large number of saves that need to be made, which is not the effect we want. We are currently taking steps to limit saves to 15 levels in order to prevent late game saves from causing lag. We are working hard to resolve this issue, but since the slow save issue involves refactoring the underlying code of the game, our internal team hopes that once the game version is stable, we will refactor the underlying logic code of the game and introduce a better save feature!
  The UI problem is a very big flaw in this game, the UI system may make you feel confused or even hard to accept, we apologise to all players for this. Due to the limited manpower in the game development and the lack of UI art resources, the UI style issue may still exist for a while, once our team finds a better UI solution, we will present you with a better UI style.
 [h1] The specifics of this update are as follows:[/h1]
1. Recalibrated 80% of the English text content.
2. Optimised the UI logic of the battle area selection panel and the UI logic of the character list.
3. The negative effects of some of the opening stats have now been weakened, and the early game will become easier.
4. The Skeleton King, Demon Lord, and Goblin Assailant now have a long range attack interval of +100% and a spell casting attack interval of -50%.
5. Blood Crow series boss character attack power +5.
6. Fixed the problem of missing character attacks in different resolutions.
7. Repair and adjust other known problems.
We always welcome your feedback on in-game imbalance data and error problems or valuable game suggestions!

notes.title: Hello players, this is Stardust Light Studios
notes.content:
Random Legion has received a lot of attention and play from players since its launch, and we sincerely thank players for giving us a chance.
We are concerned about the game into the middle and late lag will be more serious, this is our technical negligence, we have finished the school thesis defence, will be re-invested in the development of Random Legion to take measures. In the future, we will still pay attention to the game's performance problems and continue to improve the player's experience.
The content of this update is as follows:
1. Performance optimisation: alleviate lag and frame dropping issues in the late game.
2. Balance data modification to the equipment upgrade mechanism of the blacksmith shop.
3. Modification of some talent texts.
4. The character ‘Wind Bamboo’ is now an [Assassin] ties.

We are always happy to receive your feedback on the game's unbalanced data and bugs, or your valuable gameplay suggestions!

notes.title: Hello everyone, we are Stardust Light Studio
notes.content:
Many players gave their suggestions on the new content, and this feedback is very valuable to us. Our development team carefully collected and analysed players' feedback, and made systematic adjustments and optimisations in this update to address the problems in the game experience.
In addition, we have fixed several issues that may affect the smooth operation of the game, and improved the text descriptions of some skills and talents.
The main specific updates are as follows:
1. Optimised the range of character's enemy catch determination.
2. Added a dynamic price system to the shop.
3. Enemy units in different difficulty levels will also learn a different number of skills on their own according to their progress.
4. Reduced the probability of captive recruitment.
5. Increased the amount of gold obtained from levels.
6. Increased the maximum capacity of the initial team.
7. Fixed some procedural bugs, etc.

We will continue to update the game, and the suggestions we receive will be carefully considered internally and discussed with the players in the exchange group. Just to bring players a better gaming experience.
Finally, thank you for your continued attention and support

notes.title: Random Legion Demo (Final Preview version) has been updated
notes.content:
Here are the details of the update:
1. Beautify the overall UI style of the system and unify the text size.
2. The numerical balance of all characters has been completely reworked, the differences between characters and their respective characteristics will be more obvious, and the overall pace of the game is now slower.
3. Optimized the game performance and solved the problem that the frame rate of 100 people on the same screen dropped sharply.
4. Resources have been compressed for the game art textures, and the game now takes up less memory
5. The overall numerical balance system of the game has been adjusted, and players will have a refreshing combat viewing experience after a challenging start.
6. Constantly optimize the text of the game and simplify the game text content.
7. Systematically modify content based on feedback from test players.
8. Fixed several bugs that affected balance.
